title: Regular home cleaning
summary: Weekly or fortnightly care for houses and apartments by the same vetted cleaner, on the same day and at the same time.

meta.title: Regular home cleaning in Luxembourg
meta.description: Weekly or fortnightly home cleaning in Luxembourg by the same vetted, insured cleaner, on a fixed day and time. Request a tailored quote.

hero.intro: One trusted cleaner, one fixed slot, and a home that is looked after the same way every visit. We agree the details once, write them down and keep to them.

image.alt: A calm, freshly cleaned living room with plumped cushions and a chandelier

included.intro: Your checklist is agreed during the first visit and can change at any time. This is a typical starting point.

groups.title: Living areas and bedrooms
items: Dusting of furniture, shelves, frames and skirting boards
Vacuuming and mopping of all floors, including under light furniture
Beds made, with linen changed on request
Mirrors, glass tables and interior glazing spot-cleaned

groups.title: Kitchen
items: Worktops, splashbacks and cupboard fronts wiped and degreased
Hob, extractor front and appliance exteriors cleaned
Sink and taps descaled and polished
Bins emptied, with sorting for Luxembourg's recycling collections

groups.title: Bathrooms
items: Showers, baths, basins and toilets cleaned and disinfected
Limescale removed from glass, tiles and fittings

frequencies.intro: Recurring visits are always with the same cleaner, on the same day and at the same time.

faq.question: Will I always have the same cleaner?
faq.answer: Yes. Recurring visits are assigned to one cleaner. If they are on holiday or unwell, we tell you in advance and send a briefed replacement who follows your written checklist.

faq.question: Do I need to be at home?
faq.answer: No. Many clients give us a key or an access code. Keys are labelled with a code, never with your address, and stored securely. You can also be present if you prefer.

faq.question: Do you bring cleaning products and equipment?
faq.answer: We bring professional equipment and eco-responsible products suited to each surface. If you prefer particular products, we are happy to use yours.

faq.question: Can I pay with service vouchers or claim tax relief?
faq.answer: Please ask us during your consultation. We will explain which payment options apply to your situation and provide clear invoices for your records.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: Every home is different, so we quote after a short visit or a detailed call. The quote is fixed for the agreed scope and shows amounts excluding and including VAT.
